nuggets.text: Matt Entz won two FCS national titles as North Dakota State's head coach, in 2019 and 2021.
Matt Entz's son, Konner, pitches for Sacramento State's baseball team.
Matt Entz won the Arizona Bowl in his first Bulldogs season, beating Miami (Ohio) 18-3 to finish 9-4.
Matt Entz coached USC's linebackers in 2024, the season before he took over the Bulldogs.
The green V on Bulldog helmets, added by coach Pat Hill in 1997, honors the San Joaquin Valley's farm community.
The Bulldogs' live mascot tradition began in 1921, when a white bulldog showed up on campus.
Valley Children's Stadium is a sunken bowl, built with seats unusually close to the action.
David Carr became Fresno State's first No. 1 overall NFL draft pick, taken by the expansion Houston Texans in 2002.
The Bulldogs beat No. 13 UCLA 40-37 in 2021, the second-highest-ranked opponent they have ever defeated.
The Bulldogs are playing their first season as members of the Pac-12.
